preserved_limits: ZERO is nominal-structure-matched, not equal effective trainable capacity; 128 structurally zero-gradient projection weights remain a limitation.
B6 to B7 changes fusion and parameter count and does not independently identify DOTE effects.
Random scene rotation and fixed toward-east controls are proposed definitions, not evidence of physical causality or guaranteed nonzero gradients.
Training seeds are not independent weather events; event identity remains NOT_IDENTIFIED.
Historical E9 identities are saved-metadata bindings, not current weight-payload hashes.
No old successful baseline, ZERO, scientific tests or inference rerun; no new training, evaluation, calibration, bootstrap, payload, restricted-cache or 2025 access.
